1 (Currently amended): A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is __removably and replaceably__ securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, wherein the second quantity is applied to the destination using a __different__ instrument than the first quantity.

6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, __wherein the surface portion is further characterized as being at least substantially smooth__.

7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, __wherein the surface portion is further characterized as being at least substantially smooth__.

11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, __wherein the ring portion is configured to allow for easy removal and replacement__.
